positions.commentary: The speaker believes Tesla is currently overvalued and that the risks are astronomical given the price paid relative to cash flow.
The speaker acknowledges Amazon is amazing but notes its valuation is much higher today than when it was bought in the dot-com era.

thesis: The episode presents a bearish view on Tesla due to its perceived overvaluation relative to cash flow and astronomical risks, while maintaining a neutral stance on Amazon, acknowledging its quality but noting its significantly higher current valuation compared to the dot-com era.
